items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: See, Buddy P.T. is one of the only men that, that, that played trumpet. See, if he was living, he'd still be recognized in this day.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I want you to tell me about him. I don't know who he is, but I don't know where you played with him.

Oh, Bunk was one of the, oh, he's one of the big time players. He's a crackerjack player. He wasn't a musician, but he's so much of a player Bunk Johnson was. Oh, he had a wonderful record. He had the same record as Buddy P.T. died and left. See, Buddy P.T. is one of the only men that, that, that played trumpet. See, if he was living, he'd still be recognized in this day. See, I said Spider Freddy Kepa the man he'd want. See, Buddy P.T., he'd be recognized in this day. See, cause, for all that freak trumpet…
They're still playing King Quarter Stomp and Wolverine Blues. Yeah, yeah. All his numbers are still popping.
